race.comment: DIRTY DIANA (7) has been mixing form this time in but caught the eye with a strong finish to grab second here last time out, beaten a length. Doubt she has to do any more to be winning here in what looks a fairly thin affair. MARILYN'S EDGE (5) is racing okay, resuming off a short break at Mildura when fading late into fifth. Fitter for that and should give a sight. RUBY AVENUE (6) has claims on best form off a let-up, he's largely been racing on synthetic lately but he's raced well fresh and gets a good draw. MIDNIGHT DEVIL (2) is struggling for consistency but is a sharp sprinter on his day and draws for every hope.
